reviews.text:
My animals have been going to Knot to Shaggy for 11 years. My cat Athena comes for boarding and grooming with Debbie, and my two dogs, Frankie and Iris, are groomed by Victoria. All three have always been wonderfully cared for.

Athena is extremely aggressive at other boarding facilities and at the vet, yet with Debbie she is calm, gentle and happy. In Debbie's words: "I have never had one bit of trouble with her." That alone tells you how much trust she has built with my cat.

Debbie's care goes well beyond grooming and boarding. Athena struggled with vomiting for years and was in and out of the vet because of it. Debbie offered suggestions on her food and routine, and Athena has not been sick since. After years of trying to solve that problem, it made a real difference in her life and mine.

Debbie genuinely cares about every animal she looks after, and it shows. I am so grateful to her and to Victoria, and I wouldn't trust my animals with anyone else.

I've been recommending people over here for years I had a friend call while in front of me and Debbie was practically yelling and demanding this and that. You know if you don't like the clients then it might be time to hang up the hat. Needless to say I won't be back or recommending people to her any longer. What a terrible attitude..
Spreads ringworm. Doesn’t take accountability. Doesn’t sanitize the tools properly. Very upset

I see from the reviews that my indoor-only cat is not the only one to break out in a ringworm infection after being groomed at this facility.  I had her treated, and she got better, so I took her back to the groomer, giving her the benefit of the doubt, but my cat got ringworm again!  My cat has gone through many months of treatment, which has cost lots and lots of time, stress and money.  This has also forced me to keep her separated from other cats in the house, who have all tested negative and showed no signs of ringworm.  Something is very wrong if many other pets have gotten ringworm after being groomed here and the problem has not been resolved.

I’m extremely disappointed with my experience here. This is now the second time my cat, Phoebe, has contracted ringworm after being groomed at this facility.

Phoebe is strictly an indoor cat and is not exposed to other animals, so through process of elimination, this was the only place she could have been exposed. Dealing with ringworm is stressful, time-consuming, and comes with unexpected expenses, so having this happen more than once is completely unacceptable.

Because of this, I will not be returning. I strongly encourage the business to review their sanitation and hygiene practices to prevent this from happening to other pets and owners.

Turnip is so cute and soft after his groom! The owner and her assistant were very friendly and told me exactly what they would do and double checked with me about what I wanted, it was his first time at a groomer in a long time and I'm sure he was taken care of
so they are not sanitary, and wouldn't be comfortable taking my cat there. I can't trust someone again who gave my cat and apparently others too ringworm. Absolutely disgusting.

On October 13, I took my indoor only cat to Debbie for a haircut. My daughter took him back to have his haircut adjusted on October 17. About a week and a half later, we noticed red dry patches. We took him to the vet to which the vet confirmed active ringworm. A severe case at that. I explained what has been different with our cat in the last three weeks and the vet confirmed it was most likely the groomer. My daughter when she went back on the 17th watched Debbie use clippers on another cat and then proceed to use those same clippers on our cats Sparky. When I reached out to her to let her know, I got a dismissive and blame shifting answer. My cat has been getting haircuts for 11 years and has never been sick with anything other than occasional allergies. Not only has she stopped responding and refuses to take accountability, but in the following texts, she has shown that she lacks complete understanding and knowledge of how ringworm is transmitted. I understand that this may have been an accident however, the problem is here and she is doing nothing to take accountability for it. As you can see by the photos, the ringworm is only an areas that the hair has been cut. He has no ringworm on any other area of his body, other than places where her clippers have made contact.

I took my INDOOR cat here three weeks ago and just found out today that he has RINGWORM. I am BEYOND upset. He had an unblended haircut so I went back a week later and watched her use the same clipper that she used on another cat on mine. Please please please check your cats. He has NEVER in 10 years of getting hair cuts gotten ringworm.

Update: he has it only in the areas that his hair was trimmed. Check your cats if you got their hair trimmed in the last 4 weeks. Unbelievable and unacceptable.
Debby is the Cat Whisperer.  I have a very shy cat that Debby grooms and my cat loves her and her bath !   Debby is THE BEST  cat groomer !   No need to look further.  I highly recommend her!!
they gave my baby ringworm. she is an indoor cat no access to other cats no other way she would’ve gotten it. If the owner is reading this please sanitize your tools.

I’ve been taking Chantico with Debby for almost a year now and she’s amazing! she’s very knowledgeable, patient, and efficient. She’s usually done with him in under an hour and leaves him super soft and smelling good. I would definitely not go anywhere else.

Debby was amazing with my little Persian! She took the time to educate me on how to properly comb his fur and take out knots. He SMELLS amazing and the cut was done amazing! She also checked in on him later that evening since it was his first time getting a haircut/groomed and I thought that was so sweet! Also she was super fast!
My cat loves his bath. He is so happy. Great place!
Super clean shop and very fast service! Debby rocks!

I’ve been coming to Debbie for 5+ years with my ragdoll, Choupette. Her policy of only grooming one pet at a time keeps our anxiety low. Efficient too, Chou gets dropped off and picked up in an hour or less. Debbie is kind and gracious, even after getting scratched up by a disgruntled Chou. There is no better cat groomer in NTX. In addition, all of my friends and their families bring their Australian Shepherds next door to get groomed by her daughter at Knot2Shaggy. This family loves animals and your pets are in great hands here!

Wonderful!! Loved Debbie that helped our poor cat Tommy that came along way from Oregon. Mats everywhere and smelly. He’s soft and clean and happy now. She is knowledgeable and caring about cats issues. I’d go back if needed in a heartbeat!! Highly recommended!!

Debbie was amazing!  Took my 17 year old ragdoll for her first grooming, and she was masterful with her.  Many other groomers would have taken the easy way out and shaved her 3 layer difficult coat, but she worked through the matting, and she looks beautiful now after her session.

Happy old kitty!  Can't recommend enough

I have a beauitful siberian cat (lots of fur & a triple layer coat!) and I was struggling to get the mattes out and after reading the reviews, I brought her to Debby.  We went this morning and Debby was amazing!  I really think she is a cat whisperer! She treated Lirra with utmost kindnss and was able to keep Lirra calm while she combed out all the matts and then gave her a bath and blowdry - she came out smelling delightful and so soft. I didn't know a cat could smell that nice! Normally Lirra cries in the car and after her "spa day" she was so calm and didn't say a peep on the way back.  I would recommend Debby in a heartbeat and we'll be back.
I’ve used Debby for a few years. She is so dang good at what she does! It’s magic. My rag doll, Mia, and I both appreciate her expertise.

We’ve been taking our cat to see Debbie for 5+ years now. We have moved around the metroplex and tried other places for her but were never satisfied. Even when we live 30+ minutes away, we still take our cat to be groomed by Debbie. She’s the best !

Went in to book boarding for my two cats during their posted business hours. No one there in the office. No information posted, no flyers, no pamphlets, nothing. If this is how they run the office, I'm not going to trust them with my fur babies.

I have been taking my cat, Stella, to Debby for years! It is so hard to find a quality cat groomer who understands cats and makes sure they’re well taken care of while getting groomed. Debby checks all the boxes and she truly cares about …

My first visit with my rescue cat- fantastic! Debby professionally bathed and groomed my long-haired cat with care and expertise. Start to finish= 1 hour. Cost=$105. I think this price is fair for the service received. I had to wait 6 weeks …
